core_obligations: Part (1) (proof line 6595): the first page of the spectral sequence is the associated graded of K^n, so finiteness of the filtration makes the spectral sequence bounded.
Part (2) (proof line 6596): finiteness of the filtration on H^n(K) is read off from the displayed equation for the filtration on cohomology.

Part (3) (proof lines 6597-6612): the equalities characterising weak convergence hold because the terms F^{p+r}K^n and F^{p-r+1}K^{n-1} stabilise for large r; abutment follows from (2); regularity follows from boundedness by the cited lemma; and the last condition holds because the filtration on each H^n is finite.

Part (4) (proof lines 6614-6626): if E_r^{p,q} lies in a weak Serre subcategory C for all p, q then so does E_{r+1}^{p,q}; boundedness makes the spectral sequence regular and coregular, so some later page agrees with the limiting page in each total degree n, and H^n(K) therefore has a finite filtration with graded pieces in C, whence H^n(K) lies in C by the extension property.
proof_roadmap: Get boundedness from the identification of the first page.
Read finiteness of the filtration on cohomology off the displayed equation.
Verify the two weak convergence equalities and combine abutment with regularity.
Use coregularity and the extension property of weak Serre subcategories for the last assertion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a filtered complex whose filtration is finite in every degree has a bounded spectral sequence, a finite filtration on each cohomology object, convergence to the cohomology, and that the cohomology stays inside a weak Serre subcategory once some page does (statement lines 6578-6592). The proof is a complete argument: boundedness and finiteness are read off from the first page and the displayed filtration on cohomology (proof lines 6595-6596), the two equalities defining weak convergence are verified from the stabilisation of the filtration steps, after which abutment and regularity give convergence (proof lines 6597-6612), and the fourth assertion combines the extension property of weak Serre subcategories with coregularity (proof lines 6614-6626). The non-formal content is the verification of the convergence equalities and the passage from a page to the limiting page. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
